    Each fraction is a string representation with the following format, <numerator>/<denominator> where both numerator and denominator are positive whole numbers. You can assume that the fractions are valid and do not have zero as denominator.

    An expression begins with "<" and ends with ">", and contains fractions separated by commas ",". Each expression can contain more than one fraction.

    >>> check_expression("<1/2,2/1><2/3,3/2>")
